subject: Important Update Regarding Your Insurance Policy
body: Dear valued customer, We hope this email finds you well. We wanted to inform you about some important changes to your insurance policy that will take effect starting next month. These changes have been made to better protect you and ensure that you have the coverage you need. Please review the attached document for more details and feel free to contact us if you have any questions. Thank you for choosing us as your insurance provider. Best regards, Insurance Company
